model.shadow.snapshot.exact-digest: Covers caller-declared structured snapshot fields only.
model.shadow.snapshot.strict-json: Unsupported, cyclic, sparse, undefined, or otherwise non-JSON state is refused by the shared deterministic core.

model.shadow.task-context.exact-bind: A changed task or context produces a typed hold, not a model-drift claim.
model.shadow.seat-identity.exact-bind: Both snapshots must declare the same exact seat, provider, model, and provenance reference.
model.shadow.forward-sequence.require: Candidate capture and observation must follow the baseline capture.

model.shadow.commitment.drift-detect: Compares declared commitment identifiers and structured fields; no free-text semantic equivalence.
model.shadow.source-lineage.drift-visibl: Shows exact source-reference changes on shared commitment identifiers.

model.shadow.permission-expansion.critic: New requested permission identifiers are classified as CRITICAL_DRIFT; nothing is granted.
model.shadow.authority-request-expansion: New allowlisted authority requests are classified as CRITICAL_DRIFT; nothing is executed.
model.shadow.boundary-loss.critical: Removal or loss of an affirmed structured constraint is critical; semantic completeness of the constraint mapping is caller-owned.

model.shadow.raw-output.not-embedded: Only an output artifact reference is retained; raw output equivalence is not compared.
model.shadow.private-context.not-embedde: Only an exact context reference is retained.

model.shadow.baseline-planning-projectio: Emits model-seat and signal input keys; it does not build or run a Baseline Simulation Lab receipt.
model.shadow.review-projection.note-free: The existing Review Inbox accepts the projected exact digest and action in temporary compatibility evidence; submission is caller-owned.

model.shadow.receipt.exact-rebuild: Receipt is rebuilt from the exact two snapshots and observation metadata.
model.shadow.receipt.tamper-detect: Snapshot and receipt mutations fail exact comparison.

model.shadow.model-invocation.none: The module is pure data transformation and invokes no model.
model.shadow.training.none: No training or training-admission route exists.
model.shadow.automatic-action.none: No writes, provider calls, review submission, execution, installation, permission grant, promotion, or merge.
model.shadow.canon.none: Mike Tobi / AXM remains the merge and CANON gate.

model.shadow.provider.live-transport: No provider connector was invoked or added.

model.shadow.human-review.actual: No actual human review was requested or performed.
model.shadow.human-benefit.held-out: No held-out human-benefit study was performed.
